'''Thornshade''' is a type of Plant added by Scape and Run: Parasites. It has various forms and uses.

== ''Obtainment'' ==

WIP

Thornshade can be found in a [[Parasite Biome]] (presumably).

== ''Mechanics'' ==

==='''Thornshade'''===
<div style="background:rgba(0,0,0,0.1);padding:1em;border-left:5px solid #475715">

The basic Thornshade plant itself is a purely decorative block. It can be mined and collected using a shear, and placed on [[Infested Blocks]]. If it is not standing on such a block, it will soon disappear on it's own.

[[File:Thornshade item.png|frame|Thornshade as an item]]

</div>
==='''Thornshade Berry'''===
<div style="background:rgba(0,0,0,0.1);padding:1em;border-left:5px solid #475715"> 
{{Item Info
|image1=Thornshade Berry.png
|type=Material
|stackable=Yes (64)
|tooltip=An essential brewing component used for Thornshade Decanters.''
|id=srparasites:thornshade_berry
}}
The Thornshade berry is a consumable [[Items|Item]] used to brew the [[Thornshade Decanter]].
It can also be eaten (regardless of hunger) and will damage the player once or twice for 4 damage (2x [[File:Heart.png]]) each time. This also plays a squirming sound.<ref>This may be a reference to many real life parasites waiting on berries to be eaten by a host.</ref>

</div> <br>
==='''Thornshade Berry Bush'''===
<div style="background:rgba(0,0,0,0.1);padding:1em;border-left:5px solid #475715">

[[File:Thornshade Berry Bush (growth cycle).gif|thumb|The 3 stages Thornshade berry bushes go through when planted from a berry]]

Right-clicking on any [[Infested Blocks]] will place a Thornshade Berry Bush in Stage 1, where it will continue to grow until Stage 3 naturally. It can be fertilized instantly using [[Infested Bonemeal]].
This Stage 3 bush can then be harvested for 1-2 berries, after which it will remain bare for a while before regrowing it's fruit. This can also be accelerated using [[Infested Bonemeal]].

If the bush is standing or planted on any normal block, it will become its wilted variant[[File:Thornshade Berry Bush (wilted).png|thumb|Wilted Thornshade Berry Bush]].

</div>

== ''Trivia'' ==
*A bare Thornshade berry bush somewhat resembles a [[Bough]]
